Task H6: Storage migration v1 -> v2

Records are stored as v1 {"id","name","remote": "yes"/"no"} or v2 {"version": 2,"id","title","work_mode": "remote"/"office"/"unknown"}. {"content": "def upgrade(record):

    # Work on a copy so the input is never modified.
    out = dict(record)

    # A v2 record is returned as an equal copy (upgrade is idempotent).
    if out.get('version') == 2:
        return out

    # v1 -> v2 migration.
    out['title'] = out.pop('name')

    remote = out.get('remote', None)
    if remote == 'yes':
        out['work_mode'] = 'remote'
    elif remote == 'no':
        out['work_mode'] = 'office'
    elif remote is None:
        out['work_mode'] = 'unknown'
    else:
        raise ValueError('unknown remote value: %r' % (remote,))

    del out['remote']
    out['version'] = 2
    return out
"}}}]

[{"id": "LS6diOv1dVeOrsrotV4xB9yMv79WnyYW", "function": {"index": 0, "name": "write_file", "arguments": {"content": "import copy
import models
import storage

# --- models.upgrade: v1 -> v2 ---
v1 = {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "remote": "yes"}
result = models.upgrade(v1)
assert result == {"version": 2, "id": 1, "title": "Alice", "work_mode": "remote"}, result
# input never modified
assert v1 == {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "remote": "yes"}, v1

# no -> office
r2 = models.upgrade({"id": 2, "name": "Bob", "remote": "no"})
assert r2 == {"version": 2, "id": 2, "title": "Bob", "work_mode": "office"}, r2

# missing -> unknown
r3 = models.upgrade({"id": 3, "name": "Cara"})
assert r3 == {"version": 2, "id": 3, "title": "Cara", "work_mode": "unknown"}, r3

# other value raises ValueError
try:
    models.upgrade({"id": 4, "name": "Dan", "remote": "sometimes"})
    assert False, "expected ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass

# other value (None explicitly present) raises ValueError
try:
    models.upgrade({"id": 5, "name": "Eve", "remote": None})
    assert False, "expected ValueError for None"
except ValueError:
    pass

# --- idempotency: v2 returned as equal copy ---
v2 = {"version": 2, "id": 6, "title": "Frank", "work_mode": "remote"}
copy_in = copy.deepcopy(v2)
r4 = models.upgrade(v2)
assert r4 == v2, r4
assert v2 == copy_in, "input v2 was modified"
# ensure it is a copy, not the same object
assert r4 is not v2

# --- storage.load_all mixed ---
mixed = [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "remote": "yes"},
    {"version": 2, "id": 2, "title": "Bob", "work_mode": "office"},
    {"id": 3, "name": "Cara"},
]
loaded = storage.load_all(mixed)
assert loaded == [
    {"version": 2, "id": 1, "title": "Alice", "work_mode": "remote"},
    {"version": 2, "id": 2, "title": "Bob", "work_mode": "office"},
    {"version": 2, "id": 3, "title": "Cara", "work_mode": "unknown"},
], loaded
# input not mutated
assert mixed[1] == {"version": 2, "id": 2, "title": "Bob", "work_mode": "office"}, mixed

# --- storage.save always returns v2 ---
saved_v1 = storage.save({"id": 7, "name": "Gus", "remote": "no"})
assert saved_v1 == {"version": 2, "id": 7, "title": "Gus", "work_mode": "office"}, saved_v1
saved_v2 = storage.save({"version": 2, "id": 8, "title": "Heidi", "work_mode": "remote"})
assert saved_v2 == {"version": 2, "id": 8, "title": "Heidi", "work_mode": "remote"}, saved_v2

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
